fields.regle: Un phrasal verb sépare son complément quand celui-ci est un nom (« turn the light on » ou « turn on the light ») mais l'oblige au milieu quand c'est un pronom : « turn it on », jamais « turn on it ».

exercises.prompt: Traduis en plaçant le pronom : Éteins-la.

accepted: Turn it off
Switch it off

hints: Le pronom se glisse entre le verbe et la particule.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : J'ai enlevé mon manteau en entrant.

accepted: I took my coat off as I came in
I took off my coat as I came in

hints: Un nom peut se placer avant ou après la particule.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons dû annuler l'atelier.

accepted: We had to call the workshop off
We had to call off the workshop

exercises.prompt: Here is the form — could you fill ___ in before Friday?

accepted: it

hints: Un pronom se place au milieu.

exercises.prompt: The demo starts at ten; don't be late, they won't put it ___ .

accepted: off

exercises.source: Please switch off it before you leave.
exercises.prompt: Corrige et réécris la phrase.

accepted: Please switch it off before you leave

hints: Le pronom ne va jamais après la particule.

exercises.source: I looked up it in the glossary.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I looked it up in the glossary

exercises.prompt: The migration is huge — we cannot put ___ any longer.

accepted: it off

hints: Pronom entre le verbe et la particule.

fields.regle: in dit l'entrée et l'inscription : check in, fill in, drop in, join in. out dit la sortie et l'extinction : check out, go out, run out, be out.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous nous sommes enregistrés à l'hôtel vers minuit.

accepted: We checked in at the hotel around midnight

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Passe me voir quand tu es dans le coin.

accepted: Drop in when you are nearby
Drop in when you are in the area

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous sommes à court de licences.

accepted: We have run out of licences

hints: run out of = être à court de.

exercises.prompt: Could you fill ___ this form before the induction?

accepted: in

exercises.prompt: The lights went ___ during the town hall.

accepted: out

exercises.source: Everyone was invited to participate in the singing.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « join in ».

accepted: Everyone was invited to join in the singing

hints: join in = se joindre à l'activité.

exercises.source: We have run out from milk again.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: We have run out of milk again

exercises.prompt: The hotel asks guests to check ___ by eleven.

accepted: out

fields.regle: out marque souvent l'élucidation ou l'aboutissement : find out (découvrir), work out (calculer, s'arranger), sort out (régler), point out (faire remarquer), turn out (s'avérer).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons découvert la vérité trop tard.

accepted: We found out the truth too late

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il s'est avéré que personne n'avait relu le contrat.

accepted: It turned out that nobody had read the contract

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Peux-tu régler ça avec le fournisseur ?

accepted: Can you sort that out with the supplier

exercises.prompt: She pointed ___ that the pilot had never touched live data.

accepted: out

exercises.prompt: I still cannot work ___ how the invoice was calculated.

accepted: out

exercises.source: The rollout was eventually a success.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « turn out ».

accepted: The rollout turned out to be a success

exercises.source: I will find about what happened at the steering group.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I will find out what happened at the steering group

exercises.prompt: It took us a week to ___ the licensing mess.

accepted: sort out

fields.regle: on dit la mise en marche et la continuation : put on, turn on, get on, carry on. off dit l'arrêt, le départ et l'annulation : turn off, set off, call off, put off.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous sommes partis à six heures du matin.

accepted: We set off at six in the morning

hints: set off = se mettre en route.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Continue, je t'écoute.

accepted: Carry on, I am listening
Go on, I am listening

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Le comité a été annulé hier soir.

accepted: The steering group was called off last night

exercises.prompt: Put your coat ___ , it is freezing out there.

accepted: on

exercises.prompt: Don't put the handover ___ until your last morning.

accepted: off

exercises.source: How is your new team doing with the tooling?
exercises.prompt: Réécris la question avec « get on ».

accepted: How is your new team getting on with the tooling

hints: get on with = se débrouiller avec.

exercises.source: Please turn the projector out before you leave.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Please turn the projector off before you leave

exercises.prompt: They ___ the launch until the guardrails were tested.

accepted: put off

fields.regle: Autres emplois : get on with somebody (bien s'entendre), take on (embaucher, assumer), be off (partir, être absent), show off (frimer), doze off (s'assoupir), rip off (arnaquer).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je m'entends bien avec mon supérieur direct.

accepted: I get on well with my line manager

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Ils embauchent trois personnes ce trimestre.

accepted: They are taking on three people this quarter

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je suis absent la semaine prochaine.

accepted: I am off next week

exercises.prompt: He has taken ___ far too much work this month.

accepted: on

exercises.prompt: Two people dozed ___ during the second hour.

accepted: off

exercises.source: They charged us three times the going rate.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « rip off ».

accepted: They ripped us off

hints: Le pronom se place au milieu.

exercises.source: I get on well my new colleagues.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I get on well with my new colleagues

exercises.prompt: She is always ___ about her day rate.

accepted: showing off

fields.regle: up dit la hausse et l'achèvement : speed up, use up, break up. down dit la baisse et la panne : slow down, break down, cut down, turn down (baisser, mais aussi refuser).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : L'ascenseur est encore tombé en panne.

accepted: The lift has broken down again

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Ils ont refusé notre proposition.

accepted: They turned our proposal down
They turned down our proposal

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous devons réduire les déplacements.

accepted: We need to cut down on travel

exercises.prompt: Can you slow ___ ? I am still taking notes.

accepted: down

exercises.prompt: The new connector should speed things ___ considerably.

accepted: up

exercises.source: There is no printer paper left at all.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « use up ».

accepted: We have used up all the printer paper

exercises.source: My car broke up on the motorway.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: My car broke down on the motorway

hints: break up parle d'une séparation, pas d'une panne.

exercises.prompt: They ___ the job because the day rate was too low.

accepted: turned down

fields.regle: up marque aussi l'apparition et l'achèvement : turn up (arriver, se pointer), come up (surgir), bring up (soulever un sujet), give up (renoncer), make up (inventer, composer).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il est arrivé avec une heure de retard.

accepted: He turned up an hour late

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Quelque chose d'urgent est survenu.

accepted: Something urgent has come up

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je n'abandonnerai pas si facilement.

accepted: I will not give up that easily

exercises.prompt: Nobody dared bring ___ the question of the day rate.

accepted: up

exercises.prompt: The model made the whole policy ___ , footnote and all.

accepted: up

exercises.source: Only four people came to the workshop.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « turn up ».

accepted: Only four people turned up to the workshop
Only four people turned up for the workshop

exercises.source: She gave down smoking two years ago.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: She gave up smoking two years ago

exercises.prompt: Contractors ___ nearly half the team now.

accepted: make up

fields.regle: Encore up : catch up (rattraper), set up (mettre en place), do up (rénover, boutonner), take up (se mettre à, occuper), wash up (faire la vaisselle), tidy up (ranger).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons mis en place un environnement de test.

accepted: We set up a test environment

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je dois rattraper mon retard sur les mails.

accepted: I need to catch up on my emails

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Elle s'est mise au gallois l'an dernier.

accepted: She took up Welsh last year

exercises.prompt: That meeting took ___ my whole afternoon.

accepted: up

exercises.prompt: They are doing ___ the old warehouse by the water.

accepted: up

exercises.source: Could you make this desk tidy before you leave?
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « tidy up ».

accepted: Could you tidy this desk up before you leave
Could you tidy up this desk before you leave

hints: Un nom peut passer avant ou après.

exercises.source: Let's catch up about the pilot on Thursday morning.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la préposition.

accepted: Let's catch up on the pilot on Thursday morning

exercises.prompt: Who is going to ___ after the leaving drinks?

accepted: wash up

fields.regle: away dit l'éloignement et la mise de côté : go away, put away, throw away, give away. back dit le retour : come back, call back, pay back, look back, get back to somebody.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je te rappelle dans dix minutes.

accepted: I will call you back in ten minutes

hints: Le pronom se glisse au milieu.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Ne jette pas ces câbles.

accepted: Do not throw those cables away
Do not throw away those cables

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je reviens vers toi avant vendredi.

accepted: I will get back to you before Friday

hints: get back to = revenir vers quelqu'un.

exercises.prompt: Could you put those files ___ when you have finished?

accepted: away

exercises.prompt: He paid me ___ the following month, to my surprise.

accepted: back

exercises.source: She returned from Cardiff on Sunday evening.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « come back ».

accepted: She came back from Cardiff on Sunday evening

exercises.source: I will get back at you once legal has signed off.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I will get back to you once legal has signed off

hints: « get back at » veut dire se venger.

exercises.prompt: They ___ the old monitors to a local school.

accepted: gave away
